# Databricks

Unified data analytics platform built on Apache Spark.

Alternative to [[Snowflake]] for lakehouse architectures. Also implements [[Medallion Architecture]].

## Key concepts

- Delta Lake format
- Unity Catalog
- MLflow for ML lifecycle
